title: The Silent Algorithm That Decides Who Dies in a Hospital
hook: Hospitals use a hidden algorithm to ration care during disasters — and it has a secret list of who gets saved first.
why_this_can_go_viral: Reveals a disturbing system most people don't know exists, triggering fear and curiosity about who controls survival.

hook: On a remote island, clocks run reverse and scientists have no explanation for the time distortion.
why_this_can_go_viral: Time manipulation is universally fascinating; the idea of a real place where it happens is mind-bending.

title: The Underground City That Burns Nonstop for 5,000 Years

why_this_can_go_viral: Eternal fire is a primal hook; the scale and hidden nature of this phenomenon sparks awe and dread.

title: The Desert Where the Sand Screams When You Step on It
